text: A.J. Brown's return from injured reserve has hit a snag—the wide receiver missed Thursday's practice with a new knee ailment layered on top of his previously injured ankle, leaving his status for Sunday's trip to Miami in question as the Patriots prepare for their Week 8 AFC East showdown against the Dolphins. On the brighter side, the Patriots' starting secondary is healthy and ready to roll, which should give the defense some teeth as they look to notch a third division win; the secondary's availability is particularly welcome as New England looks to build on their performance from the first seven weeks of the season. The Dolphins, who are looking to build momentum against the defending AFC champion Patriots, feature a roster mostly unfamiliar with facing New England at this level, though Willis, a member of Miami's coaching staff, brings some familiarity with how the Patriots operate. Sunday's kickoff is set for 4:15 PM ET in Miami, and early survivor pool strategists are already eyeing the Patriots as a smart play this week.
